w.started: The computer accepted {{p}}. Waiting for it to start…
w.runningScreen: {{p}} is running. Its window hasn't appeared yet.
w.ready: {{p}} has a window on the display.
w.unknown: {{p}} may still be starting. The computer didn't confirm it.
w.foreign: We can't tell whether this is the {{p}} that was started.
w.execLost: {{p}} may have started before this key lost permission.
w.handoff: {{p}} ended without a window here. If {{p}} was already running on this computer, it may have passed {{file}} to that copy.
w.code127: {{p}} ended with code 127. That usually means the program isn't on this computer.
w.code126: {{p}} ended with code 126. Usually it couldn't be run (permissions, or the computer couldn't start it).
w.code125: {{p}} ended with code 125. If the folder couldn't be entered, the terminal says so.
w.code: {{p}} ended with code {{n}}. Show the terminal to see why.
w.endedNoCode: {{p}} ended. The computer didn't say how.
w.execOff: This key can no longer start programs on this computer, so nothing was started. Sign in with your account, or use a key that may start programs.
w.notDurable: This browser couldn't save its note that prevents opening twice, so nothing was started.
w.noBash: Files can't start programs on this computer: no bash program was found on it.
w.warming: The computer is getting its program list ready. Try again in a moment.
r.held: {{p}} may still be starting with {{file}} from before, so it wasn't started again.
r.handoffAgain: Last time {{p}} closed without opening a window here. It may have passed {{file}} to a copy of {{p}} that was already open. Start it again?
r.full: Too many opens are still unconfirmed. Check or remove some in Programs > Apps.
r.noAccount: Sign in again to start programs.
r.tooLarge: This open couldn't be recorded, so nothing was started.
r.noPlan: To start it again, open the file from Files.
r.collision: This path is part of the program's own command; open it from a terminal.
r.noHandle: {{p}} may have started; we can't check it.
r.removeHoldAsk: The earlier start may still be running, so the app may open twice. Stop tracking it anyway?
ow.chooser.title: Open “{{file}}” with
ow.chooser.checking: Checking which programs this computer has…
ow.chooser.noScreen: We couldn't confirm this computer has a display. If it has none, the program ends with an error you can read in its terminal.
ow.chooser.launcherFailed: We couldn't check whether this computer can start programs from Files. Refresh to check again.
ow.chooser.cmdHelp: $1 is the file. The command runs in the file's folder.
ow.chooser.cmdHelpDir: $1 is the folder. The command runs in that folder.
ow.chooser.cmdTooLong: The command is longer than {{n}} bytes.
ow.chooser.always: Always use {{p}} for {{type}} on this computer
ow.chooser.alwaysPick: Always use the program I pick for {{type}} on this computer
ow.chooser.oversized: Not saved: too many saved choices on this browser
ow.chooser.locked: Saved choices can't be read on this browser
ow.chooser.nothingKept: No program is remembered for this kind of file. Use Open with… to pick one.
ow.chooser.gone: {{p}} is not on this computer any more. Use Open with… to pick another program.
ow.chooser.nameRefused: {{p}} would read this file name as something else, so it wasn't started. Pick another program.
ow.chooser.notExecutable: Only a file that can be run (its execute bit set) runs in a terminal.
ow.chooser.pathRefused: Files can't start a program on this path from here.
ow.chooser.kept: The earlier start couldn't be cleared, so it still blocks a new start.
ow.chooser.dropped: The computer or account changed before anything was sent, so nothing was started.
ow.chooser.droppedKept: The computer or account changed before anything was sent, so nothing was started. The start it reserved couldn't be cleared, so it stays reserved.
ow.chooser.holdRemoved: Stopped tracking it. The next open starts the program again.
ow.chooser.holdKept: Couldn't stop tracking it. Do it in Programs > Apps.
ow.chooser.placedElsewhere: The app was started. Find it in Programs > Apps.
ow.sqlite.name: SQLite Studio
ow.sqlite.note: Opens this database in the computer's SQLite Studio, in a new tab.
